card.name: Words just before pen-/sen- word starts
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (and, as, in, a comma) right before a likely word that starts with pen, sen or hem. Seen in drug-pair lists such as amoxicillin and, and in Vietnam war text.

modes.label: Drug pair linking word
modes.description: The word 'and' after a drug name in lists of combined regimens, where another drug name follows.
modes.example: with amoxicillin<< and>> omeprazole or lansop

modes.label: Linking words in war text
modes.description: A comma, 'in' or 'during' in text about the Vietnam War and Southeast Asia.

modes.label: Other small slots
modes.description: Odd spots like a Malay word 'bagi' or a space before a dose.

card.writes: It nudges the next word toward beginnings like pen, sen and hem, and away from endings like roid.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words right before a name or word that likely starts with pen or sen.
